name: Quota lookup — generations left for this IP

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/quota. Serves User Story 11: the generator shows how many generations are left before the user starts, not after a failure.

nodes.name: Resolve client IP and date
nodes.notes: Extracts the real visitor IP from x-forwarded-for and escapes it into a Firebase-safe key. A private or missing address is treated as broken detection.

nodes.name: Read today's counters
nodes.notes: One read for both counters. The /quota subtree is denied to clients by the database rules, so only this service account can see it.

nodes.name: Build quota status
nodes.notes: Returns the QuotaStatus shape from src/app/core/recipe.ts. When IP detection failed, the system-wide counter is used so the quota cannot silently become unlimited.
